grade_rationale: 5 P1 findings (exceeds max_p1:2 threshold for grade C). 4 critical CVEs including RCE vectors. 17 P2 findings.

dev_workflow_platform.note: excluded — config maps wrong source dir; see QO-001

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.exploit_scenario: AST type confusion allows arbitrary JS execution during template rendering
escalations.fix: Update direct dep pulling handlebars to require >=4.7.10

escalations.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing / Auth Bypass (CVSS 9.1)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Forged X-Forwarded-For with IPv4-mapped IPv6 bypasses subnet trust; req.ip returns spoofed value
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update express (upgrades proxy-addr to >=2.0.8)

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/Execute (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Any machine reaching the Vitest UI port can read and execute arbitrary project files, no auth required
escalations.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest (target >=5.0.5 for tinypool fix too)

escalations.title: Tinypool Prototype Pollution → RCE Gadget
escalations.exploit_scenario: Prototype pollution of worker/run options triggers code execution in worker processes
escalations.fix: Resolved by updating vitest to >=5.0.5 (see DEP-003)

p1_findings.title: Inspector config specs.dir maps to wrong application layer
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: specs.dir points to portal/ app specs; source.dirs points to workflow engine. All drift analysis results are invalid.
p1_findings.fix: Update specs.dir to Plans/, fix traceability pattern to FR-[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]+

p2_findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer — direct store imports
p2_findings.fix: Extract store calls into service functions; routes call services only

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed not implemented — no code, no traceability
p2_findings.fix: Create idempotent seedDependencies() function, wire to app.ts startup

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing from metrics.ts
p2_findings.fix: Add Histogram to prom-client imports; define and instrument dependencyCheckDuration

p2_findings.title: body-parser DoS via trailing bytes after compressed body
brace-expansion DoS — 6 CVEs (CPU exhaustion, OOM, stack overflow)
p2_findings.fix: Update all deps using brace-expansion; update npm/npx/package managers

p2_findings.title: js-yaml quadratic CPU consumption — 4 CVEs
p2_findings.fix: Direct update or update packages depending on js-yaml

p2_findings.title: nanoid infinite loop / integer overflow — 3 CVEs
postcss path traversal / arbitrary file read — 4 CVEs
form-data CRLF injection in multipart field names
ws memory exhaustion DoS via tiny fragments
vite multiple path traversal CVEs — 8 vulnerabilities
p2_findings.fix: npm update vite (>=8.3.5) — MAJOR VERSION, run full test suite

p2_findings.title: vitest/mocker path traversal + code injection — 2 CVEs
pino 2 major versions behind (8.17.0 → 10.x)
p2_findings.fix: npm update pino@latest in Source/Backend — check v10 breaking changes

p2_findings.title: react-router-dom outdated + open redirect CVE
p2_findings.fix: npm update react-router-dom@latest (v7 — route API migration required)

p2_findings.title: vite 3 major versions behind + 8 CVEs (see DEP-014)

p3_findings.title: OpenTelemetry tracing not instrumented
p3_findings.fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + Express HTTP middleware, or document exception in CLAUDE.md

p3_findings.title: Logger always emits JSON — no dev pretty-print
p3_findings.fix: Add NODE_ENV !== 'production' branch for readable output

p3_findings.title: React 1 major version behind (18.3.1 → 19.x)
p3_findings.fix: npm update react react-dom (requires component testing)

p4_findings.title: eslint-disable exhaustive-deps in 2 hooks
p4_findings.fix: Audit whether intentional; use useCallback/useRef instead of suppressing

p4_findings.title: Traceability enforcer only checks most-recent plan in CI
p4_findings.fix: Wrap enforcer in a loop over all Plans/*/requirements.md; update CLAUDE.md gate

p4_findings.title: Moderate CVEs in esbuild/jest transitive deps
p4_findings.fix: Resolved when vite and vitest are updated

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Fix inspector.config.yml specs.dir and traceability pattern
cross_reference_map.impact: Makes all future drift analysis valid
